text:
maria_gomez: Pushed microq-v2-int8 to the canary pool ~2h ago. Quick heads up — funcall tests are spiking on structured-output compliance. Sample attached.

devon_h: uhh can you paste the exact output? parser error or non-json? :thinking: 

maria_gomez: Not a hard parse error. It's valid JSON but fields come back in different order and the tool-call array sometimes gets an extra trailing comma (looks model-side). Example: 

maria_gomez: ```json
{"action": "create_ticket", "args": {"description": "user issue",}, "tool_sequence": ["validate", "enqueue"]}
```

alex_kim: trailing comma inside args -> technically invalid in strict JSON. That explains our funcall schema linter complaining. Did microq int8 step change tokenization of punctuation?

sasha: we saw similar with zephyr-lite before — quant-induced tokenization can emit stray commas when generation stops mid-token. usually shows up in tail text.

maria_gomez: Telemetry: parse_fail_rate for funcall endpoint jumped from 0.6% -> 6.3% after onboarding within same prompt set. Canary runs show highest variance on short prompts with suffix-based tool calls.

devon_h: can we reproduce in local mirror? run_canary --model microq-v2-int8 --tests funcall-smoke --seed=42

maria_gomez: ran that, attached logs to the canary artifacts. Repro is noisy but present ~3/100 samples. I dumped token stream; see snippet: 

maria_gomez: ```
... "description\": "user issue",  -> tokens: ["\", ", 125, 9]
```

alex_kim: Hmm token boundary leak. Two quick mitigations: 1) apply a strict JSON post-processor that strips trailing commas and normalizes ordering (cheap) 2) adjust decode finish rules to prefer end-of-structure tokens for funcalls (brittle).

sasha: Agreed. For immediate canary safety should we enable a lightweight repair step in the runtime (post-invoke): try parse -> if fails, run json-repair heuristics (remove trailing commas, close open braces) -> re-parse -> emit repaired parse + metric?

maria_gomez: I can add that as an opt-in canary flag. We should also add an eval to Redwood Optimize: rerun 10k funcall prompts and measure repaired vs original correctness.

devon_h: Also add a boolean telemetry field repaired=true/false to avoid double-billing or masking model regressions. We want to capture root-cause, not hide it.

ci-bot: deploy-notification: Canary deployment microq-v2-int8 -> 2024-05-12T09:12:00Z. Artifact: s3://canary-artifacts/microq-v2-int8/17188722/logs.tar.gz

alex_kim: For medium term, open issue to test different quant recipes (per-channel vs per-tensor) and compare funcall parse-failure rates. Might be a kernel-level tokenization side-effect.

maria_gomez: Plan for next 72h: 1) opt-in repair hook in canary (maria) 2) telemetry field + metric dashboard (devon) 3) 10k-run evaluation in Optimize and record baseline (sasha) 4) schedule quant-recipe A/B (alex). I'll post PR for the repair hook tonight.

devon_h: ack. If repair hook increases accuracy >90% but hides reg, keep it opt-in until quant fix is found.

sasha: adding task to run the tokenizer-level diff on the failing samples. Might expose specific token IDs causing the comma.

maria_gomez: thanks team. tagging @alex_kim for the quant recipe experiment and @devon_h for telemetry. :raised_hands:

alex_kim: noted. I’ll spin a couple quant variants tomorrow and attach to the canary matrix. :shipit:
